usage: Concept exploration only; A approved for Blender implementation.

concepts.title: PRESSURE GATE
concepts.description: Option A: High-pressure curved pylons. Each thick ivory cylindrical fabric column stands rigidly inflated from a grounded vermilion padded base, with broad vermilion stripe and one short checker cuff. Upper quarter bends OUTWARD away from the road like a softly curved horn, giving a strong symmetrical gateway silhouette but completely clear central opening. Rounded closed tip, NOT a flapping arm, NOT an arch spanning road. Short narrow fabric pennant at outward tip trembling in wind. Each base has a visible low compact industrial centrifugal blower with circular dark protective grille, corrugated air duct and two sandbags. Restrained gentle pole flex indicated by one faint ghost outline only in inset. The taut bulging body and fluttering tip must convey powerful airflow.
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: early colored game prop design sketch for Brushline Rally, a retro screenprint rally racing game. Draw a clean landscape concept sheet, warm off-white paper, loose construction pencil and crisp gouache color-block rendering, petroleum teal, warm ivory, vermilion orange, charcoal NOT pure black, small black/ivory checker accents. Show TWO matching inflatable checkpoint markers, one on each side of a gravel rally road, about 3.5 m tall and an unobstructed 6 m driving gap, no overhead crossbar. Large main three-quarter frontal overview, simple small pale gray rally hatchback in the middle for scale (only car has dark contour lines); environmental props shaded in clean color blocks without heavy black cartoon outlines. Small inset at bottom right shows the blower, fabric construction and airflow/motion arrows as design annotations. Large quiet margin. Keep design practical to model and animate in Blender, visible fabric seams, stitched panels, soft tension and bulges, functional ground ballast and blower air hose. Focus on marker design, no cinematic detailed landscape, no HUD, no sponsors, no real brands, no people or faces, no confetti, no watermark. concepts.title: WIND DANCER
concepts.description: Option B: Flexible wind-dancing taper columns. Each inflated tube has a broad stable vermilion lower third and an ivory/orange alternating upper section tapering upward with two short fabric ribbon tails at its open mouth. Both upper sections bend and ripple dramatically OUTWARD away from drivable space in different graceful S curves; playful air-dancer energy, but abstract equipment, no anthropomorphic face, no arms or hands. Distinctly supple accordion-like folds at bends compared to rigid A. Blower visibly connected at each weighted base. Inset shows three small silhouettes of the upper tube bending outward, rebounding upright, bending outward, with simple motion arrows. Strong readable inflated volume, no inward collapsing tube over the car.

concepts.title: VORTEX BEACON
concepts.description: Option C: Sculptural vortex wind beacons. On each side of the road a stable squat inflated support column carries a large vertical circular inflatable fabric ring, about 1.4 m diameter, ring plane facing the approaching car. Ring resembles a soft padded turbine inlet, but NO turbine blades, no metal engine. Through each ring's clear center is attached a long striped tapered fabric windsock: open wide at ring, narrows and streams toward the rear/outside of the road under powerful air, leaving central roadway completely open. Ring is vermilion and warm ivory with a small checker segment, lower support petroleum teal and ivory. Visible blower and duct at base feed internal pillar and ring; air-stream lines only in construction inset explain the wind sock. Inset side view shows the ring as an inflated fabric rim and the striped windsock stretched behind it, fluttering only at its far end. Distinct from a normal pole or air-dancer.
